title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
title_zh: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响
authors: Zhifeng Cai
abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)
abstract_zh: 摘要 生成式人工智能正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个关于人工智能的社会学习模型，强调数据与人工智能之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响人工智能的生产力，进而影响人工智能的采用，并最终决定未来数据的构成（人工智能生成与人类生成）及其质量。基于合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测劳动力动态呈驼峰形——短期替代效应会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。一种格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨式外部性由此产生：人工智能采用者搭便车，依赖人类生成的行为提供人工智能自身所需的新信息。在竞争性市场中，应对人工智能征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中化的人工智能行业则会过度纠正，使得补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）

title: How households reason and behave when deposit rates become negative
title_zh: 负利率下家庭推理与行为研究
authors: Asger Lau Andersen, Niels Johannesen, Jens Petersen, Sonja Settele, Johannes Wohlfart
abstract: How households behave in an environment with deposit rates below zero is important for monetary transmission, but the literature is scant. This column studies household behaviour in the context of a major episode of negative interest rates in Denmark. This authors find that the negative deposit rates led to a strong decrease in deposits. Households appear to react more sharply when interest rates below zero are cut compared to when rates are positive. As depositors seem to consume more rather than hold more cash, policy rate cuts in negative territory may have particularly strong consumption effects.
abstract_zh: 家庭在存款利率为负的环境中的行为对货币传导至关重要，但相关文献较为匮乏。本文以丹麦负利率重大事件为背景，研究家庭行为。作者发现，负存款利率导致存款大幅减少。与正利率时期相比，当利率降至负值区间时，家庭反应更为剧烈。由于储户似乎更倾向于增加消费而非持有更多现金，负利率区间的政策利率下调可能对消费产生尤为显著的影响。

title: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study
title_zh: 想到什么工作？关于学科领域的刻板印象
authors: John J Conlon, Dev Patel
abstract: Abstract We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using both surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University and large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how US freshmen perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which correlational evidence on job/major mismatch corroborates. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们检验了高 stakes 经济环境中的刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。通过俄亥俄州立大学本科生调查及大规模全国代表性数据，我们测量了美国新生对大学专业与职业之间关系的认知。研究表明，学生极大高估了专业导向其代表性职业的可能性（例如心理学专业对应咨询师、新闻学专业对应记者）。通过内隐联想测试，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联强烈预测信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过加剧资源错配降低社会福利，而关于职业/专业错配的相关证据证实了这一点。在实地实验中，我们测试了一项轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，发现该政策对学生学习意向、所选课程及专业注册产生了显著影响。

title: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
title_zh: 最低工资标准是否增加了残疾工人的就业风险？来自最低工资上调与次最低工资废除的证据
authors: Roisin O'Neill, Shailee Manandhar, Douglas L. Kruse
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: People with disabilities are disproportionately represented in low-wage work, raising concerns that higher wage floors may reduce their employment opportunities, particularly for workers with more severe disabilities. We examine the effects of state minimum wage increases and state subminimum wage terminations on employment outcomes for people with disabilities using American Community Survey data from 2010–2023. We find little evidence that minimum wage increases reduce employment or labor force participation among people with disabilities, including those with more severe disabilities. While many estimates are statistically imprecise, confidence intervals generally rule out economically meaningful negative employment effects. We likewise find no evidence that terminating subminimum wages reduces employment opportunities for affected workers, and some estimates suggest positive employment effects for groups most likely to have been employed under subminimum wage arrangements. These gains may reflect complementary policies that often accompany repeal, such as Employment First initiatives. Overall, the results provide little support for the view that higher wage floors create disproportionate employment barriers for people with disabilities.
abstract_zh: 残疾人在低薪工作中占比过高，这引发担忧：更高的工资下限可能减少其就业机会，尤其是对残疾程度更重的劳动者。我们利用2010-2023年美国社区调查数据，研究各州最低工资上调及取消次级最低工资对残疾人就业结果的影响。研究发现，几乎没有证据表明最低工资上调会降低残疾人（包括重度残疾者）的就业率或劳动参与率。尽管许多估计值在统计上不够精确，但置信区间通常排除了具有经济意义的负面就业效应。同样，我们未发现取消次级最低工资会减少受影响劳动者的就业机会，部分估计甚至表明，最可能受次级最低工资制度影响的群体出现了积极就业效应。这些改善可能源于伴随废除政策实施的配套措施（如“就业优先”计划）。总体而言，研究结果不支持“更高工资下限会为残疾人制造不成比例的就业障碍”这一观点。

title: Income Mobility of the Top One Percent
title_zh: 顶层百分之一的收入流动性
authors: David Splinter, Jeff Larrimore
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 美国收入前1%群体的流入与流出变动显著：一年后三分之一退出，十年后三分之二退出。这种流动性在将收入衡量周期从年度扩展至多年时，会降低顶层收入份额。二十年的代内流动性使近期前1%的财政总收入份额下降超过10%，前0.1%份额下降超过20%，前0.01%份额下降30%，前0.001%份额下降40%。收入波动对财富不平等的影响幅度与之相似，但就顶层财富不平等占比而言更为温和。

title: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
authors: Loukas Karabarbounis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Micro estimates of the Marshallian elasticity of labor supply are small and typically positive, whereas cross-country and time-series patterns of hours imply a strong negative relationship between wages and hours. I reconcile these two apparently contradictory observations using a single utility specification and taking into account heterogeneity in non-labor income. Micro estimates condition on non-labor income, while macro variation allows capital income to adjust alongside labor income, which strengthens the income effect. A model with heterogeneous households and exogenous capital income yields closed-form expressions in which the distribution of the labor share shapes the gap between the micro and the macro elasticities. A cross-sectional regression of hours on wages that conditions on the labor share recovers the macro elasticity. A dynamic model with heterogeneous households and incomplete asset markets reproduces both elasticities as outcomes when disciplined by joint moments of wages, hours, consumption, and wealth. The income effects that bridge the gap between the two elasticities imply marginal propensities to earn that lie in the range of estimates of micro studies on lottery winners.
